description: This file contains shell script code for testing the behavior of Git revision parser and pathspec matching functionalities. It defines various test cases to verify how directory paths, revisions, and metacharacters are interpreted during Git operations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or timestamp for test reproducibility.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files or strings.
